issues.quote: It had stopped. That is all I know of it. It stopped with its master.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the atelier regulator, its stopping, or any time connected with it. It gives no time of death.
issues.misreading: 'It stopped with its master' implies the regulator stopped at the moment of Aurèle's death. A solver could take the regulator's stopped reading as the time of death, or as a clock reading that fixes when the murder happened. That is a timing hint the sheet does not provide.
